items.name: Greatsword
items.description: This immense two-handed sword is nearly as tall as its wielder. Its lower blade is often somewhat dulled to allow it to be gripped for extra leverage in close-quarter fights.

items.name: Javelin
items.description: This thin spear is well balanced for throwing but is not designed for melee use.

items.name: Full Plate
items.description: Plate mail consists of interlocking plates that encase nearly the entire body in a carapace of steel. It is costly and heavy, and the wearer often requires help to don it correctly, but it provides some of the best defense armor can supply. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Padded Armor] and a pair of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Gauntlet]{gauntlets}.

defensiveAbilities.name: +2 Circumstance to All Saves Vs. Fear
Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Consecrated
offensiveAbilities.description: As long as the Consecrate ritual effects persist in Crownhold, a Gorumite veteran gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, skill checks, saving throws, and Perception checks; these bonuses are not calculated into the stat block.

offensiveAbilities.name: Greatsword Critical Specialization
offensiveAbilities.description: On a critical hit with a greatsword, the target of the critical hit is knocked off-balance and becomes Off-Guard until the start of the Gorumite veteran's next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Heavy Swing
offensiveAbilities.description: The Gorumite veteran Strikes with their greatsword, dealing 4d12+22 slashing damage plus 1d6 persistent bleed. This counts as two attacks when calculating their multiple attack penalty.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pinning Throw
offensiveAbilities.description: The Gorumite veteran attempts a ranged Strike with their javelin, dealing (3d6+22) Piercing Damage damage. If the target is adjacent to a solid surface, they become stuck to that surface by the javelin. The target is Immobilized until they Escape dc=33. The creature doesn't become stuck if it is incorporeal, is liquid (like a water elemental or some oozes), or could otherwise escape without effort.
